chatgpt_surface: current ChatGPT connector invocation using the configured CodexGPT App

case_result.notes: The configured CodexGPT App returned an opaque workspace_id for the exact pinned non-default target. The next connector call explicitly reused that same handle for read(package.json) and succeeded. The returned root was the pinned target. The read result SHA-256 exactly matched the target package.json and differed from the configured profile/default-root package.json, directly excluding default fallback. The connector API does not expose the underlying MCP transport/session id, so this run does not claim that transport rotation was observed. Forced two-transport rotation is covered separately by STEP-493 integration tests.

campaign_decision: The real connector continuity defect observed in STEP-490 no longer reproduces on the successor working tree, and the no-default-fallback condition is proven. This current-conversation probe is not a fresh-conversation A1 benchmark score, so do not start A2/candidate scoring in this STEP. Run the fixed bootstrap plus verbatim A1 prompt once in a fresh ChatGPT Web conversation before resuming scored Phase 0 cases.
